proposals.title: Require a conditioned simple-model benchmark before flow escalation
proposals.claim: A matched temporal benchmark will distinguish a conditional flow's incremental distributional value from gains obtainable by composition-aware simple models.
proposals.mechanism: Compare copy-last, whole-cell mixture resampling, covariance-preserving conditional-state residual resampling, linear latent trend and flow. Match composition, permitted inputs and tuning budgets; report de_score, de_direction, mmd_u and variogram. Enumerate feasible embryo-held-out interpolation/extrapolation splits first.
proposals.falsifier: Once data are available, reject escalation if flow fails to improve preregistered distribution metrics beyond embryo-level uncertainty versus the strongest simple comparator, or if gains disappear under matched composition and sampling.

evidence.says: Diffusion expert must challenge fashionable use and assess conditional generation and transport.
Existing evaluator consumes supplied h5ad candidates and uses a small proxy; it does not train biological models.
Regularized dynamic transport uses biological priors and evaluates held-out intermediate distributions.

proposals.title: Separate missing stationarity evidence from transport falsification
proposals.claim: An evidence audit will find that the available source does not substantiate the asserted project-wide falsification of transport methods.
proposals.mechanism: Record the missing stationarity artifact as unverified, then require method-specific stage-conditioning and growth-prior ablations before interpreting changes in mmd_u, variogram or neighborhood_mmd as rejection of a transport family.
proposals.falsifier: Locate the actual test, data provenance and executable analysis showing that each named method and its relevant assumptions were tested with adequate uncertainty; revise the evidence status if found.

evidence.says: Persona asserts blanket transport falsification but points to artifacts absent from this supplied workspace.

peer_responses.on: diffusion-r1-1 comparator fairness and sparse temporal validation
peer_responses.because: Accepted whole-vector residual sampling and split-feasibility audit. Neurl IPS 2026/prompts.md:788-843 supports baselines/conditioning, not input availability. Marginal gains cannot identify paths; SF2M AISTATS 2024 demonstrates shared ODE/SDE marginals.

self_correction: Initial comparator omitted an explicit covariance-preserving conditional-state residual sampler and overpromised rolling-origin feasibility. Added it, matched composition, and require stage/embryo enumeration before choosing temporal tests. Retain PROCESS; defer architecture escalation.
declined: Immediate high-dimensional score-SDE training: no biological data or demonstrated failure of simpler conditioned models exists. Also declined the inherited conclusion that all transport methods were falsified by an absent test.
